> **DannyBruza:** Dinesh & I am starting a sister site to Holography forum, its holographers.org ....

Nice! I recently purchased a hologram from Kris Meerlo. It's simply the best reflection hologram that I've ever held in my hands (including my own holograms, sadly ;').

I'd love to see a place where I can see and purchase more holograms made by current artists using modern equipment and recording materials.

A word of advice: KISS!!! (Keep It Simple Stupid!) The easier it is to contribute, the more contributers you will have.

-Phil
